results.title: On Paper
results.overview: A struggling screenwriter finds his latest script mirroring real-life murders, plunging him into a paranoid spiral. As his imagination takes a delusional and dark turn, he must untangle whether he’s inspired by a killer, haunted by one, or becoming one himself.

results.title: From Nothing to Nowhere
results.overview: In a small, underdeveloped town whose only source of income is soon to be taken away by a new highway, a BnB owner turned amateur documentary filmmaker, a guru, a British artist and the latter's mechanical chicken, decide to protest the passage's construction, believing for it to be a massive conspiracy that intends to reach an oscillator constructed by Nikola Tesla that's supposedly buried deep within the mountain.

results.title: Distance to Independance
results.overview: It's the late 1980s and the once seemingly undying Soviet Union is beginning to show signs of collapse, leaving thousands of members of the Ukrainian diaspora in the US and Canada with a chance of returning to the home they have always dreamed of living in. Afraid for their lives, but fueled by patriotism, thousands of them venture to Europe in order to provide the support to their friends relatives and their countrymen through times of crisis and violent protests, culminating in the last 99 days of the USSR and the birth of an independant Ukrainian nation.

results.title: Amityverse: End Game
results.overview: Third and final horror anthology in the Amityverse series, featuring 10 more Amityville-themed segments.

results.title: The Last Fifteen Minutes
results.overview: While a giant monster attacks their city, the queer inhabitants of a small residential building (portrayed by hand-carved puppets) try to make their peace with imminent death — through music, sex, and lasagna.

results.title: The Fin
results.overview: In a post-war, ecologically devastated Korea, mutated outcasts known as Omegas are exploited as cheap labor. Su-jin, a young government worker, begins to question the state's ideology as she pursues Mia, an Omega living in hiding.

results.title: Ghost Buzzer: Antar Aku Pulang
results.overview: Four mystery-loving friends investigate a haunted basement and encounter the spirit of Maria, who begs for help returning home. Their mission leads them on an adventure filled with terror, puzzles, and friendship as they help the spirits find peace.

results.title: Lactar
results.overview: A 62-year-old woman, trapped in a life of empty privilege, becomes pregnant by her driver. Facing rejection from her family and society, she decides to fight to bring to life a baby that seems impossible at her late age, regardless of the consequences.

results.title: Exchange Gift
results.overview: Two couples check into a resort for fun and intimacy, but a reckless deal between the men shatters trust and crosses unforgivable boundaries. When betrayal and lust explode into pain and heartbreak, love turns into a cruel game no one truly wins.

results.title: Legends of the Lost Ark
results.overview: Chronicles archaeologist Dr. Chris McKinny’s search for the Ark of the Covenant. Supported by insights from scientists, historians, and biblical scholars, he explores three ancient legends pointing to final resting place of the iconic relic.

results.title: Good Luck
results.overview: A young man desperately tries to win over the girl he loves, but when all his efforts fail and she keeps avoiding him, his mischievous twin brother steps in to help—creating unexpected chaos along the way.

results.title: Mildred Moyer: Diary of a (Loveable) Psychopath: True Crime
results.original_title: Mildred Moyer: Diary of a (Loveable) Psychopath: True Crime
results.overview: Obsessed with true crime videos, Mildred Moyer decides to create her own content by hunting local criminals—recording every gruesome moment of her latest spree for the world to see, found footage style!

results.title: Métronomie
results.overview: Gianni is determined to finish an unfinished piece of music he found on his older brother's computer. His goal will turn out to be more complicated than expected, because of his inability to compose.

results.title: God Forgives Everyone
results.overview: Arturo is a lonely, gluttonous, and disillusioned Sicilian real estate agent. His mundane life finally finds its spark through his one true passion: Sicilian pastries. It’s over a tray of cannoli that he meets his soulmate, Flora. She is everything he ever dreamed of—beautiful, witty, and brilliant. To top it off, she’s a pastry chef.  However, a divine obstacle stands between them: God.  While Flora is a devout, fervent Catholic, Arturo abandoned his faith as a child. Desperate not to lose the woman of his dreams, he decides to "fake it 'til he makes it," pretending to be a man of deep conviction. Guiding Arturo on this chaotic journey toward truth, faith, and Flora’s heart is an unlikely mentor and friend: Pope Francis himself.

results.title: Try!
results.overview: Four Irish Rugby teams who defy stereotypes tackle their way to the Mixed Ability Rugby World Cup, where full-contact sport meets joyful belonging.

results.title: Sugar
results.overview: A salon owner and young mother navigates life with her increasingly abusive partner.

results.title: Bonded
results.overview: When two sisters return to their childhood home after their elderly parents untimely death, they are forced to confront the disturbing truths hidden in the walls of the house. As their past comes to light, reality begins to distort, threatening to unravel their sanity.

results.title: Cadencia
results.overview: On the night her single mother is appointed as the first female concertmaster in the institution's history, nine-year-old Lola wanders the orchestra halls alone on her birthday, until an impulsive act exposes the distance between them.

results.title: Will Power
results.overview: When a catastrophic stroke destroys the creative half of his brain days before his international breakthrough, a celebrated rebellious Russian performer wakes paralyzed - unable to walk, speak, swallow, or sing. Filmed over several years, WILL POWER follows his fragile and nonlinear rehabilitation as fame fades and his family turns away. What begins as a medical recovery becomes something deeper: a dramatic confrontation with identity, limitation, and choice. Challenging the certainty of prognosis, the film explores the possibility that the boundaries defined by science are not always the limits of human will.
